title: Capacity Guard
subtitle: Protect high-value capacity and refill gaps fast.

status.shadow: Shadow mode: nothing is blocked or sent

heatmap.title: Holds heatmap
heatmap.desc: Active holds by day and start hour.
heatmap.legend: Cell shows value / campaign / released counts

gaps.title: Gaps to fill
gaps.emptyDesc: When a job is cancelled or a no-show, the freed slot appears here and offers go out within a minute.

history.title: Backfill history
history.emptyDesc: Filled and expired gaps from the last 30 days will show here.
history.note: Estimate = candidate's expected value at claim time. Invoiced = actual invoice on the booked job.

settings.title: Settings
settings.enabledHint: Off by default. Start in shadow mode to see what it would do.
settings.minProb: Release holds below this demand probability
settings.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can change these settings.

preview.title: What would have happened last week
preview.desc: Replays last week's real high-value requests and cancellations through your current settings.
preview.waitlistOnly: Estimated fills from the waitlist only (conservative: other sources need per-customer consent checks that run live).
preview.assumptions: Claim rates are priors, not measured. Treat as an estimate, not a promise.

claim.title: Claim this appointment
claim.claimedDesc: We've booked {{slot}} for you and sent a confirmation text.
claim.filled: Sorry, someone else just took this time.
claim.filledDesc: We'll keep you in mind for the next opening.
claim.error: Something went wrong. Please try again or call us.
claim.unavailable: This time is no longer available.
